description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class UserAPITest that tests the functionality of the UserAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup routines and multiple test methods with data providers to verify API operations such as getAll, getOne, create, and update on user data.

classes.name: UserAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the UserAPI, testing CRUD operations and utilizing data providers for multiple test scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables before each test execution.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all users via the UserAPI endpoint using provided test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the getAll test method from a YAML configuration.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single user by ID via the UserAPI endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for the getOne test method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new user via the UserAPI endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test case data for the create test method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing user via the UserAPI endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test case data for the update test method.

methods.name: enableSocialMediaAuthPreHook
methods.description: Enables social media authentication prehook by updating the OpenIdProvider entity status in the database.
